purpose: Compute per-lane agent trust from history with an explicit weighted formula, small-sample intervals, drift and breakers, and Goodhart-resistant anti-terms.

competency_questions.question: What history fields and lane keys does trust require?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: lists required fields and agent task_type keying

competency_questions.question: How are accept_rate_fp and mean_Q_norm computed with windows?
How do lanes and competence vectors prevent invalid generalization?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: per-lane trust object and prior blend until n>=3

competency_questions.question: How does small-sample inference use Wilson or Beta?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: Wilson 95 or Beta interval; width flag

competency_questions.question: What is the trust formula with weights?
How are drift, severity, and timeouts used?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: 0.15 drop or miss streak; major plus severity; timeouts count

competency_questions.question: How does self_report_gap implement Goodhart resistance?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: gap definition and multi-term anti-gaming rationale

competency_questions.question: When do intervals and windows force caution?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: width>0.25 flag; rolling window; blend while small n

competency_questions.question: What opens a circuit breaker and how does recovery work?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: 2 timeouts or 3 fail streak or trust floor; canary half-open

competency_questions.question: How are telemetry, stability, and baselines exported for routing?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: components and n exported; variance and baseline rules noted

glossary.definition: Share of deliveries accepted with revise_count<=1 in a lane window
Mean artifact_Q/10 over accepts in the rolling window
Mean over-claim rate claimed_pass minus verified_pass in unit interval
Major plus defects found in others over found plus later missed
95 percent Wilson score interval for binomial proportions
clamp01 of 0.50 accept_fp plus 0.25 mean_Q_norm plus 0.15 catch minus 0.10 gap
Pause lane assignments after timeout fail or trust floor triggers
Competence dimension such as content-author or verify
Mix published lane prior with observed trust until n>=3
Per-agent map of lane trusts with n ci_width and breaker_state

source_registry.description: heuristic priors for agent reliability scoring aligned with EXCHANGE scoring scaffold
source_registry.citation_or_locator: heuristic prior; operational scoring practice; no external dataset supplied

nodes.definition: Define per-agent history records: agent_id, task_id, task_type, gates_pass, revise_count, artifact_Q, self_claimed_pass, integrator_verified_pass, xverify_defects_found, xverify_defects_missed, timeout, timestamp. Schema is the substrate for reliability metrics; without it trust is vibes.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: scores updated from chat memory without structured history rows

pros.example: each accept writes one history row

acceptance_tests: history schema documented with required fields

nodes.definition: Track competence per task_type (content-author, code-build, verify, judge, integrate), not one global skill. Lane vectors prevent a strong verifier from being over-trusted as a content author without evidence. Minimum n per cell before observed trust dominates priors.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: global trust assigns content build after only verify successes

failure_modes: one global score for all work
acceptance_tests: task_type enum fixed; trust keyed by agent and task_type

nodes.definition: first_pass_accept_rate = count(accepted with revise_count<=1) / count(delivered) per agent lane. Use Wilson score interval at 95 percent when n<30 instead of raw proportion.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: raw 100 percent accept rate claimed after n=1

nodes.definition: mean_Q_norm = mean(artifact_Q)/10 over accepts in lane window (default last 20 or 90d). Links artifact quality into agent trust. Exclude FAIL rows without Q.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: trust ignores Q and only counts accept binary

cons.claim: Slow windows lag sudden quality drops

failure_modes: include null Q as zero wrongly

nodes.definition: xverify_catch_rate = defects_found_in_others / (found_in_others + missed_later_on_same) for verify-lane work, using major+ severity. Rewards correct catches; canary-found misses lower it. No verify work imputes neutral 0.5 or excludes weight.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: verifier rubber-stamps peers yet gains trust

pros.example: onboarding refusals can score verify lane

cons.claim: Bold catches later judged style nits need severity filter

acceptance_tests: catch and miss fields; severity filter

nodes.definition: self_report_gap = mean(1[self_claimed_pass] - 1[integrator_verified_pass]) over window, clipped to [0,1]. Over-claiming reduces trust (Goodhart guard). Under-claiming does not raise trust alone.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: agent claims gates clean when content is template clone

cons.claim: Noisy early labels can create false gap

acceptance_tests: history has claimed and verified; gap used in trust

nodes.definition: trust(agent,task_type)=clamp01(0.50*accept_rate_fp_wilson + 0.25*mean_Q_norm + 0.15*xverify_catch_rate - 0.10*self_report_gap). If n<3, blend 0.7*lane_prior + 0.3*observed. Implementable default; integrator owns weight changelogs.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: trust is a gut ranking with no formula

cons.claim: Fixed weights may need lane retuning
cons.example: verify lane may want higher catch weight

nodes.definition: For rates with n<30, report Wilson 95 percent interval or Beta-Binomial with Beta(1,1) prior. Routing may use point estimate but must widen exploration when interval width >0.25.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: n=2 agent monopolizes lane from raw 100 percent

acceptance_tests: small-sample policy uses Wilson or Beta

nodes.definition: Flag drift when rolling accept_rate or mean_Q drops by >=0.15 absolute vs prior window, or >=3 consecutive misses. Mark DEGRADED_WATCH and raise verification sampling.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: quality falls for two weeks with no flag

nodes.definition: Open circuit if: 2 consecutive timeouts, OR 3 consecutive FAIL/REVISE with same blocking class, OR trust <0.35 with n>=5. Half-open after canary pass. Protects pipeline from repeated failure.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: agent keeps receiving tasks after two timeouts

acceptance_tests: breaker thresholds and half-open rule written

nodes.definition: Prefer multi-term trust, anti-terms (self_report_gap), integrator verification, and rotating canaries. Any single rate will be gamed if it alone gates rewards.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: optimize only accept_rate by shipping shape-pass shells

pros.claim: Multi-term plus gap resists single-metric gaming
pros.example: clone farming docks Q and gap

acceptance_tests: trust has multiple terms including gap

nodes.definition: Until n>=3 in a lane, trust_blend=0.7*lane_prior+0.3*observed; then observed weight >=0.8. Priors come from published routing table, not self-claims.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: prior alone assigns forever despite bad observed results

cons.example: consider n>=5 for high risk lanes

nodes.definition: Record timeouts and deadline misses as first-class failures. Timeout rate enters drift and breaker logic. Distinguish infrastructure timeout vs agent hang when possible.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: timeouts omitted from history so trust stays high

cons.claim: Infra blips can unfairly dock agents

nodes.definition: Compute rates on rolling windows (default last 20 tasks or 90 days) with optional exponential decay half-life 45d for mean_Q. Prevents ancient glory from masking recent failure.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: lifetime accept rate hides last ten fails

failure_modes: window shorter than 3 with no interval

nodes.definition: Classify defects blocker/major/minor. Only major+ count in xverify_catch_rate and error docks by default. Prevents nit-farming from inflating verify scores.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: fifty style nits count as fifty catches

pros.claim: Severity filter keeps catch rate meaningful

cons.claim: Borderline major minor disputes need examples

acceptance_tests: severity enum and examples; catch uses major plus

nodes.definition: Export per-cell trust components and n for dashboards. Show formula inputs, not only final trust.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: dashboard shows single trust without components

nodes.definition: When breaker open or DEGRADED_WATCH, assign small canary tasks; success moves half-open to closed and updates trust. Canaries are real gated tasks, not free trust resets.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: breaker clears on promise without canary deliverable

nodes.definition: For high-risk lanes, estimate stability; high variance lowers effective trust (example subtract 0.05 if rolling std of Q >1.5). Stability is part of reliability.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: agent alternates Q=9 and Q=3 with same trust as stable Q=6

failure_modes: penalize all variance including hard MED
acceptance_tests: optional variance term documented for high-risk lanes

nodes.definition: History and scores are append-only for agents; only integrator may correct with audited entries. Builders cannot edit trust inputs. Integrity failures void dependent routing until repaired.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: builder rewrites scores.json to raise trust

nodes.definition: Compare agent lane metrics to baseline (team median or prior self). Regression if mean_Q drops >=1.0 vs baseline with n>=5. Baselines make absolute rates interpretable.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: absolute rate looks fine while below all peers

cons.claim: Weak peer set makes median easy

nodes.definition: Publish the vector of per-lane trusts for each agent as the routing input object: {agent_id, lanes: {task_type: {trust, n, ci_width, breaker_state}}}. Downstream routing must consume this object rather than free-text reputation.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: router reads narrative bios instead of competence vectors

edges.why_related: high claimed success vs verified honesty
edges.resolution_rule: verified outcomes only raise accept_rate; gap docks over-claim

edges.why_related: pause assignments vs need recovery attempts
edges.resolution_rule: reserve canary slots while breaker open; no full traffic
blend until n>=3 then observed dominates

priority_rationale: Verified multi-term trust dominates self-report; per-lane evidence dominates global reputation; breakers dominate hopeful reassignment.

required_checks: all edge ids unique EDGE_XXX format
all from/to in edges reference valid node ids
all competency_question_refs resolve to valid CQ ids
all evidence_refs resolve to valid source_registry ids
all priority_order entries are valid node ids with no duplicates
high_risk_nodes (risk_if_wrong>=0.80) have non-empty acceptance_tests and human_review_required=true
conflict edges have signed_tension<0 and resolution_rule present
observed_impact=0.0 for all nodes (no observed data)
19-24 nodes, 32-40 edges, 8-10 conflict_axes, 10-12 edge_cases, 9-12 workflow steps
post_formula_checks: all derived fields non-zero after compute run

evaluation_suite.regression_policy: re-run evaluation suite after any node addition or formula change
